title: Mass protests sweep France as huge crowds demand higher wages

title: Netanyahu rival Eisenkot secures broad backing in bid to form government
description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he will announce on Sunday, November 8, whom he will task with trying to form a new government, after the opposition's Gadi Eisenkot secured a commanding number of recommendations to replace Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Commentator Douglas Herbert has more.

title: How Israel is tightening its grip on Palestinian schools in East Jerusalem
description: Israeli restrictions on teachers and pressure to adopt Israeli curriculum threaten Palestinian education in the city.

title: Global tech stocks plunge over fears of AI curbs in US
description: Asian markets plunged Friday, tracking a sell-off in Western stocks following the US midterm elections.

title: Israel’s President Herzog to name candidate to form government on Sunday
description: Announcement comes after majority of Israeli lawmakers endorse Eisenkot over Netanyahu.

title: Why is Iran exempting India, China, Qatar, Iraq from Hormuz restrictions?
description: Tehran says ships from four countries can cross Hormuz freely, but analysts say the deals carry political risks.

title: In Athens’s pro-Palestinian heartland, Israeli buyers spark resentment
description: In Athens’s pro-Palestinian heartland, Israeli buyers spark resentment

title: Tech stock rout, driven by US AI fears, continues in Asian trading
description: Global markets are being roiled due to concerns over US data centre expansion and AI regulation.

title: UK jailing of Indian sailor over Russia sanctions sets off ‘perfect storm’
description: Captain Ajay Pant was in international waters when his allegedly shadow tanker was captured by British soldiers.

title: US judge halts construction of Trump’s triumphal arch in Washington, DC
description: A 14-day pause has been ordered blocking the so-called Arc de Trump project in Washington, DC.

title: Lebanese pack bags and stock up amid fears of new Israeli escalation
description: Lebanese who lived through two Israeli escalations are stocking up and packing bags in case of a third.

title: Nigerian court rules opposition candidate cannot stand in elections
description: The high court has sacked the leadership of the opposition ADC party with only months to go until elections.

title: Guarded Optimism, and Some Jokes, in Ukraine Over Trump’s Midterm Wipeout
description: Victory for Democrats could alter the course of peace negotiations and a war nearing its fifth year.

title: Somalia's top court rejects president's term extension amid political crisis
description: The country's first nationwide elections since 1969 are due next year - a timetable now thrown into doubt.

title: Major construction ongoing near Iran missile bases, satellite images suggest
description: Evidence of digging and new buildings are visible in satellite imagery taken in November, satellite images suggest.

title: In French City Hit by Terrorist Attack, Residents Blame Far-Right Rhetoric
description: In Trappes, a suburb of Paris with a large immigrant population, residents believe that a shooting rampage was fueled by years of anti-immigrant sentiment.

title: European Countries Push, Again, To Deport Migrants to Rwanda
description: Five European nations are closing in on a plan to send rejected migrants to Rwanda following a failed U.K. deal with the country.

title: A Summit in China With Trump and Putin? That Might be Awkward for Xi.
description: A summit could bolster Xi Jinping’s stature. But talks about Ukraine’s future and limits on nuclear weapons pose uncomfortable choices for China.

title: Saudi-Led Forces Bombed Yemeni Home, Killing Nine Family Members, Relatives Say
description: The attack in October cast a spotlight on civilian casualties in the Saudi-led and U.S.-assisted bombing campaign against the Houthis.

title: Europe Still Sees Trump As Powerful, Especially in Foreign Policy
description: The commanding victory of the Democrats has brought private relief to some Europeans but no official glee, with Ukraine, Iran and NATO all hanging in the balance.

title: Марко Рубио опроверг слухи об уходе из администрации Трампа
description: Госсекретарь США Марко Рубио опроверг предположения западных СМИ о том, что он может покинуть администрацию Дональда Трампа, чтобы участвовать в президентских выборах 2028 года, пишет The New York Times.
